title: Bath & Body Works’ New Home Fragrance Collection Is Designed to Elevate Your Décor
summary: The aesthetically pleasing collection features several new products across five ambrosial scents.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Bath & Body Works is expanding its home fragrance inventory with The Reserve Collection. Launched today (Aug. 24), the line includes candles, room mists, infused reed diffusers, diffuser vessels, Wallflower bulbs and Wallflower heaters across five scents: santal and amber, vanilla and tonka, sea salt and musk, lavender and jasmine and sweet orange and agave. The vessels and candle jars also make a case for home fragrance as décor, with a neutral, polished look designed to complement a wide variety of interiors.

That matters most in spaces where the details are on display. A coffee table, after all, is more than just a place to support a plate during dinner in front of the TV. It’s an opportunity to show off your personality through stacked fashion books, matchbooks collected at your favorite restaurants, artisan coasters, decorative candles and pretty diffuser vessels. Displayed together, The Reserve Collection’s pieces can turn everyday surfaces into stylish arrangements while adding fragrance to the room.

LARGE CANDLE

The Reserve Collection Four-Wick Candle

Five Colors & Scents

$29.95

Buy Now at Bath & Body works

Boasts 50 to 70 hours of room-filling fragrance.

The Reserve Collection four-wick candle is Bath & Body Works’ largest ceramic-vessel candle, designed for maximum ambience and longer burning time. The four-wick candles are available in the collection’s five scents in coordinating jar colors, including the standout santal and amber blend — a cashmere, sandalwood and amber profile that gives the collection its warmest edge. The decorative, ribbed ceramic jars will also add an aesthetic layer to your space.

DIFFUSERS

The Reserve Collection Fragrance-Infused Liquidless Reeds & Vessel

Diffusers Sold Separately

$14.95

Spill-free by design.

The Reserve Collection diffuser reeds feature fragrance-infused, liquidless reeds that last up to 30 days. Add more or fewer reeds to customize the fragrance intensity in order to make it subtle or make it strong. Choose from santal and amber, vanilla and tonka, sea salt and musk, lavender and jasmine or sweet orange and agave. We recommend the vanilla and tonka blend for a cozy sweetness with a twist.

The diffuser vessel, on the other hand, brings a touch of vintage-style décor to your home, as the “Bath & Body Works” impressed marks give an antique pottery feel to this practical ornament. The diffuser vessels come in five colors and are sold separately from the diffuser reeds.

SPRAY

The Reserve Collection Room Mist

Five Scents

Fill the room with an aroma more quickly.

The Reserve Collection room mist pairs a new formula with a new bottle, offering a quick way to refresh a space. Choose from the collection’s five fragrances — santal and amber, vanilla and tonka, sea salt and musk, lavender and jasmine and sweet orange and agave. For best results, mist into open areas of the room.

SINGLE-WICK

The Reserve Collection Single-Wick Candle

$18.95

Gift packaging included.

The Reserve Collection single-wick candle brings fragrance and décor together in a boxed ceramic vessel that works as both a home accent and a pre-packaged gift. Available across the collection’s five scents — santal and amber, vanilla and tonka, sea salt and musk, lavender and jasmine and sweet orange and agave — each candle jar comes in a coordinating color designed to complement its fragrance. Expect 30 to 50 hours of room-filling scent from this embellishing candle.

PLUG-IN

The Reserve Collection Wallflower Heater

Five Colors

$16.95

Plug-in Wallflower heaters are sold separately from refill Wallflower bulbs.

The Reserve Collection Wallflower heater is the plug-in base for Wallflower fragrance bulbs. Simply plug in the heater, attach a bulb and adjust the fragrance intensity to suit your space. The heater separates from the refill, so you can replace only the bulb when your fragrance runs out.

RE-FILL

The Reserve Collection Wallflower Bulb

$7.95

Refill Wallflower bulbs are sold separately from plug-in Wallflower heaters.

The Reserve Collection Wallflower bulb is a fragrance refill designed to pair with the Wallflower Heater. Each bulb delivers flameless fragrance for up to 30 days, with adjustable intensity to suit smaller or larger rooms. Available in the collection’s five scents — santal and amber, vanilla and tonka, sea salt and musk, lavender and jasmine and sweet orange and agave.

Shop The Reserve Collection at Bath & Body Works to elevate your home’s fragrance and décor.
